blind.description: A small ornate casket or treasure chest with a curved arched lid, deep reddish-brown panels, and gold metal accents. It features gold corner reinforcements, banded rims, four decorative claw feet, and a golden latch ring on the front. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and stylized.
blind.from_above: A rectangular reddish-brown surface with gold borders on the sides, four corner feet protruding slightly outward, and a small gold latch protrusion along the front edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/7 the height of the figure (around 9-10 inches tall) and about 1 foot wide.
